title: Older message discarded
description: Two client messages for the same GUID arrive out of order: the newer one first, then an older one. The Lambda must accept the first (newer) and silently discard the second (older) without returning a failure. The DynamoDB record must reflect only the first message's data.

expect.outcome: success — both messages processed without error; second is silently discarded
expect.note: numero_dac must be 2 (from the newer message), not 9. version stays at 1 because the second message was discarded without a write.
